name: Off-site Backup
summary: Copies the newest encrypted server backup to S3-compatible storage on a nightly schedule.
description: An Actions-only app that uploads the newest encrypted backup to your own bucket. It asks for backups:read (it cannot read the backup key) and notify:email, to email you when a backup fails.

application.description: Copies the newest encrypted server backup to S3-compatible storage on a nightly schedule.

settings.name: S3_REGION
settings.description: Object storage region (use us-east-1 for MinIO)

settings.name: API_BASE_URL
settings.description: Base URL of this Automaton server's API, for example https://api.example.com

settings.name: NOTIFY_EMAIL_TO
settings.description: Who gets the failure email: administrators (default), owner or project

settings.name: RETENTION_DAYS
settings.description: Keep backups newer than this many days (default 30)

settings.name: MIN_BACKUPS
settings.description: Always keep at least this many newest backups (default 7)

settings.name: S3_PREFIX
settings.description: Optional folder for this install's copies; empty uses automaton/<server host>/<app ID>/
